biotools.summary: scMethCraft is a versatile analytical toolkit designed for single-cell DNA methylation (scDNAm) sequencing data. It uses a hybrid neural network to accurately model and reconstruct DNA methylation landscapes for analyzing epigenetic heterogeneity.
